resources.string: PDFs and subfolders move to the parent folder. Nothing is deleted. Resolve duplicate folder names first.
The entire folder, all subfolders and their private PDF copies, notes and reading progress will be deleted. External originals remain unchanged.

Back up all PDFs, folders, reading progress, bookmarks, embedded notes and annotations, and app settings. Choose a location using the Android file picker. Caches and decrypted viewing copies are excluded.
No successful backup recorded on this device.

Optional: enter a password of at least 8 characters to encrypt the backup. Leave both fields empty for an unencrypted backup. Without encryption, anyone with the file can read its contents. A forgotten password cannot be recovered.
Enter the backup password. Leave empty if the backup is not encrypted.
Please select the backup location again. Passwords are not retained after restarting the screen.
Preparing… Large libraries need temporary free space.

Verified: %1$d PDFs, %2$d folders. Created: %3$s
Recommended: import as a new collection. Existing PDFs, progress and settings remain unchanged. Replacement also restores app settings.

Replace the entire current library and app settings with this backup? Current PDFs, folders and progress not in the backup will be removed. Create a backup of the current library first if you want to keep it.
Library restored. Some settings could not be applied yet; they will be retried on restart.
